payment.description: A credit or debit card is required to book your appointment.
payment.cancellationPolicy: We ask that you please reschedule or cancel at least 24 hours before the beginning of your appointment or you may be charged a cancellation fee of $50. In the event of emergency, contact us directly. Your card will be held in case of late cancellation and for future purchases. It will not be charged now.
